What are the main Radix legal entities?

RDX Works Ltd is a UK-based software company assisting with the development of the Radix Ledger and related software.

Radix Foundation Ltd is a UK-based not-for-profit that has as its objectives education and furthering understanding in the Radix technology and application of the technology underpinning the Radix Ledger. 

Radix Tokens (Jersey) Limited is a Jersey-based company and wholly-owned subsidiary of the Radix Foundation. It is the issuer of the eXRD and the entity that first instantiated the Radix Ledger.

Radix Publishing Ltd is a Jersey (Channel Islands) company and wholly-owned subsidiary of the Radix Foundation. It is responsible for the publication of the open source code that allows the Radix Ledger to be run.

‍Metapass (Radix) Limited is a Jersey-based company and wholly owned subsidiary of the Radix Foundation that operates the Instapass Digital Identity service.

Metaverse (Radix) Limited is a Jersey-based wholly owned subsidiary of RDX Works Ltd that operates the Instabridge Cross-Chain Asset service.
